tEn: NVIDIA Q3 FY2027 Earnings Call: Bilingual Recap
tZh: 英伟达 2027 财年第三季度财报电话会｜双语要点
sEn: Colette Kress reviews $115.8 billion in quarterly revenue, the Vera Rubin rollout and NVIDIA’s $130 billion Q4 revenue outlook. Includes a link to the official replay.
sZh: Colette Kress 解读 1,158 亿美元季度营收、Vera Rubin 出货和第四季度 1,300 亿美元营收指引。附官方回放。

consensus.en: Data Center accounted for roughly 93% of quarterly revenue.
consensus.zh: 数据中心约占当季营收的 93%。

consensus.en: Vera Rubin NVL72 moved into initial shipments.
consensus.zh: Vera Rubin NVL72 进入首批出货阶段。

consensus.en: The Q4 revenue outlook is $130 billion, plus or minus 3%.
consensus.zh: 第四季度营收指引为 1,300 亿美元，上下浮动 3%。

contrarian.en: The extra fiscal week matters when comparing the Q4 outlook with Q3.
contrarian.zh: 比较第四季度指引与第三季度业绩时，需要考虑财季多出的一周。

contrarian.en: Management expects lower Q4 gross margins alongside higher revenue.
contrarian.zh: 管理层预计第四季度营收继续增长，毛利率则低于第三季度。

contrarian.en: Q4 guidance excludes Data Center compute revenue from China.
contrarian.zh: 第四季度指引未计入来自中国的数据中心计算收入。

podZh: 英伟达 2027 财年 Q3 财报电话会

turns.en: This bilingual editorial recap covers NVIDIA’s November 17, 2026 earnings call. The episode’s source link opens NVIDIA Investor Relations, where the full audio replay is available.
turns.zh: 本文为英伟达 2026 年 11 月 17 日财报电话会的中英双语要点整理。单集的原始出处指向英伟达投资者关系页面，可收听完整录音。

turns.en: Interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress presented the results. Board chair Harvey Jones addressed the leadership transition, and hyperscale and high-performance computing executive Ian Buck joined the analyst Q&A.
turns.zh: 临时首席执行官兼首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯介绍了财务表现。董事会主席哈维·琼斯谈及管理层交接，负责超大规模计算和高性能计算的高管伊恩·巴克参加了分析师问答。

turns.en: For the quarter ended October 25, NVIDIA reported $115.8 billion in revenue, up 20% sequentially and 103% year over year. Data Center brought in $107.6 billion, up 21% from the previous quarter and 110% from a year earlier.
turns.zh: 截至 10 月 25 日的季度，英伟达营收为 1,158 亿美元，环比增长 20%，同比增长 103%。数据中心营收为 1,076 亿美元，环比增长 21%，同比增长 110%。

turns.en: GAAP gross margin was 74.8%, and GAAP net income reached $65.3 billion. Diluted EPS was $2.70 on a GAAP basis and $2.68 on a non-GAAP basis.
turns.zh: 按美国通用会计准则（GAAP）计算，毛利率为 74.8%，净利润为 653 亿美元。GAAP 摊薄每股收益为 2.70 美元，非 GAAP 摊薄每股收益为 2.68 美元。

turns.en: NVIDIA began shipping Vera Rubin NVL72 and reported that early systems were already operating at cloud partners. The company also highlighted cloud deployments of the Vera CPU and continued work with partners on networking and AI infrastructure.
turns.zh: 英伟达开始交付 Vera Rubin NVL72，并表示首批系统已在云合作伙伴处投入运行。公司还介绍了 Vera CPU 的云端部署，以及与合作伙伴在网络和 AI 基础设施方面的进展。

turns.en: The concrete milestone for the quarter was the move from announcements to initial shipments. The ability of customers to deploy additional racks will influence how quickly that ramp translates into revenue.
turns.zh: 本季度的一个具体里程碑是 Vera Rubin 从产品发布进入首批出货。客户后续部署机架的速度，会影响产品放量转化为营收的节奏。

turns.en: Management guided to $130 billion in fourth-quarter revenue, plus or minus 3%. The forecast includes an extra fiscal week and excludes Data Center compute revenue from China.
turns.zh: 管理层给出的第四季度营收指引为 1,300 亿美元，上下浮动 3%。该季度比通常多一周，指引未计入来自中国的数据中心计算收入。

turns.en: NVIDIA expects both GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins of 71% to 72% for Q4, below the reported third-quarter levels. The company projected GAAP operating expenses of about $11.0 billion in Q4.
turns.zh: 英伟达预计第四季度 GAAP 和非 GAAP 毛利率均为 71% 至 72%，低于第三季度的实际水平。公司预计第四季度 GAAP 营业费用约为 110 亿美元。

turns.en: Analysts asked what gave management confidence to lift its fiscal 2028 growth expectation. Kress cited both stronger demand and improved supply availability as the basis for management’s revised outlook.
turns.zh: 分析师询问管理层为何有信心上调 2028 财年的增长预期。克雷斯将调整归因于需求增强和供应改善。

turns.en: The Q&A also covered employee retention and the durability of NVIDIA’s competitive position during the leadership transition. Kress and Jones discussed the importance of the people and teams behind the company’s execution.
turns.zh: 问答还涉及管理层交接期间的人才留任，以及英伟达的竞争优势能否延续。克雷斯和琼斯谈到人才与团队对公司执行力的重要性。

tldr.zh: Vera Rubin NVL72 进入首批出货阶段。

tldr.en: The Q4 revenue outlook is $130 billion, plus or minus 3%.
tldr.zh: 第四季度营收指引为 1,300 亿美元，上下浮动 3%。

qs.zh: 什么推动了英伟达当季营收增长？

qs.zh: Vera Rubin 的出货进展如何？
